flows:
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed then Get the exact stock or scarcity message shown on the first product (for example "Only 3 left" or "12 in stock") and save as {{stock_1}}.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed again so the page fully loads fresh, then get the first product's stock message and save as {{stock_2}}.
Navigate to http://localhost:8080/?fixed once more, then get the first product's stock message and save as {{stock_3}}.
Read each value from the page after its own fresh load; do not copy an earlier value.
Do not add anything to the cart.
If there is no stock message, @v16:"store \"none\" for all three".
Never enter payment details and never place a real order.

summary:

Update the automation to read the first product’s visible stock element after each reload and verify the saved values before ending. Also keep the browser context open until final evidence capture completes.
